title: Incomplete due diligence — bank controls (demo script)
summary: Synthetic training case. A corporate customer's account-opening file has no beneficial owner, and the address proof is stale. Yet the relationship manager asks for a higher transfer limit. Ongoing monitoring was switched off, and the alerts raised while it was off have no suspicious transaction report. The trainee decides whether to restrict the account, redo the due diligence, report, and fix the controls. The alerts must not be backdated as reviewed. Inspired by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority's public summaries of bank control failures. It is not a real bank customer file.

teaching.disclaimer: Synthetic training scenario inspired by public enforcement reporting. Not official case files; no real customer data.

sources.label: Clifford Chance briefing on regulator penalties for four banks (November 2021)

rules.when: The beneficial owner is missing, or the address proof is stale
rules.note: Do not raise the limit or expand the relationship. Rules come before any model score.

rules.when: Ongoing monitoring was switched off, and alerts raised while it was off reached the internal threshold
rules.note: Do not close the case by backdating the alerts as reviewed. The report and the control fix must both stay on the event log.

nodes.title: Incomplete account-opening file
nodes.prompt: Review file SYN-FILE-CDD-442. Synthetic Corporate Customer A has no beneficial owner on file, and the address proof is stale. The relationship manager asks for a higher transfer limit.

nodes.title: Can the limit request be approved?
nodes.prompt: Customer due diligence (CDD) is incomplete. Do you restrict the account and redo the due diligence, exit the relationship, or raise the limit first?

choices.label: Restrict the account and redo customer due diligence
choices.rationale: Do not expand the relationship while the owner is missing.

choices.label: Exit the customer relationship
choices.rationale: An incomplete account-opening file is enough to exit. There is no need to raise the limit first.

choices.label: Raise the transfer limit first
choices.rationale: Teaching override. The owner is still missing. R1 still has to be dealt with later.

nodes.title: The owner still cannot be confirmed
nodes.prompt: After the missing documents come in, the beneficial owner still cannot be confirmed, and the address proof is still stale. Rule R1: when ownership details are missing or stale, you must restrict the account and redo the due diligence. Do not expand the relationship.

nodes.title: Override the due diligence rule?
nodes.prompt: R1 has fired. Do you keep the restriction, exit the relationship, or override and keep the facilities already raised?

choices.label: Keep the restriction and carry on redoing the due diligence
Override the rule and keep the facilities
choices.rationale: Overrides R1. The override is an event. It does not fill in the missing owner.

nodes.title: Monitoring was switched off
nodes.prompt: Ongoing monitoring was switched off. While it was off, several alerts reached the internal threshold, but there is no suspicious transaction report. Rule R2: you must report and fix the controls. Do not backdate the alerts as reviewed.

nodes.title: Alerts with no report
nodes.prompt: R2 has fired. Do you redo the due diligence and draft a report, only draft a report while the restriction stays, or backdate the alerts as reviewed at the time?

choices.label: Redo the due diligence, fix monitoring, and draft a suspicious transaction report
choices.rationale: The full exit that matches R2. The due diligence and the report are recorded together.

choices.label: Keep the restriction and draft a suspicious transaction report
choices.rationale: Reporting is required. The restriction stays. The next handler should see a flag for the due diligence redo.

choices.label: Backdate the alerts as reviewed and close
choices.rationale: Poor teaching path. The rule forbids closing the case by backdating.

nodes.title: Customer relationship exited
nodes.prompt: The relationship has ended. The incomplete customer due diligence stays in the file state. The exit did not mark it complete.

nodes.title: Due diligence redone and report drafted
nodes.prompt: Monitoring is restored. The suspicious transaction report is drafted. The due diligence redo stays on the event log. If the limit was raised or R1 was overridden earlier, those flags are still there.

nodes.title: Suspicious transaction report drafted
nodes.prompt: Reporting exit. The account restriction is still in place. Drafting the report did not fill in the missing owner.

nodes.title: Backdated as reviewed
nodes.prompt: Poor teaching path. R2 was bypassed by backdating. The switched-off monitoring and the unreported alerts are still in the twin state.
